svg.desc: Reply and prompt speed of six models on the NPU, GPU and CPU, and embedding and rerank throughput. Prompt reading and reply writing speed of Qwen3.5 4B and LFM3-Omni 2B on the NPU, GPU and CPU. Reading the prompt, 2,048 tokens; Qwen3.5 4B on NPU 934 t/s; Qwen3.5 4B on GPU 188 t/s; Qwen3.5 4B on CPU 64.5 t/s; LFM3-Omni 2B on NPU 2,358 t/s; LFM3-Omni 2B on GPU 490 t/s; LFM3-Omni 2B on CPU 167 t/s; Writing the reply, up to 128 tokens; Qwen3.5 4B on NPU 15.3 t/s; Qwen3.5 4B on GPU 15.1 t/s; Qwen3.5 4B on CPU 12.1 t/s; LFM3-Omni 2B on NPU 36.3 t/s; LFM3-Omni 2B on GPU 38.4 t/s; LFM3-Omni 2B on CPU 33.0 t/s. Reply writing speed with and without speculative drafting. JSON extraction, 1.1× slower with DFlash; Without 15.4 t/s; Drafted 14.0 t/s; Code edit, 8.0× faster with n-gram and MTP; Without 14.9 t/s; Drafted 120 t/s. Model load time per chip, the time to stop a reply, to the first spoken audio, and to come back to a chat. Qwen3.5 4B on NPU 5.2 s; Qwen3.5 4B on GPU 40.3 s; Qwen3.5 4B on CPU 7.9 s; LFM3-Omni 2B on NPU 2.2 s; LFM3-Omni 2B on GPU 9.6 s; LFM3-Omni 2B on CPU 2.8 s; Stop a reply 85 ms; First spoken audio 378 ms; Back to a 3,000-token chat 8.3 s; Back to a 3,000-token chat 5.1 s.
